name: Phyrexian Metamorph
oracle_text:
({U/P} can be paid with either {U} or 2 life.)
You may have this creature enter as a copy of any artifact or creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
blocked_sentences: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any artifact or creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.

needs.what: the `self_enters_as_copy` replacement's `except_` needs an `add_types` key (707.9b) that writes card types into the copy's copiable values, so `{"add_types": ["Artifact"]}` makes a copy of a nonartifact creature an artifact creature for as long as it is a copy
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `self_enters_as_copy` (Spark Double, Dack's Duplicate, Chameleon) exists with `copying` able to say `any_types: ["Artifact", "Creature"]`, but `ENTERS_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS` in cards/loader/__init__.py accepts only add_keywords, remove_supertypes, name and enters_with, and `move_object` in engine/zones.py sets no type addition on the object. Dropping the clause would make a copy of a nonartifact creature lose the artifact type, a different card. `copy_overrides.add_types` exists in characteristics.py for `copy_permanent` token copies but is not reachable from the as-enters replacement
needs.suggested_fix: add `add_types` to ENTERS_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS, validate against KNOWN types, and in the `self_enters_as_copy` branch of `move_object` store it (e.g. `obj.copying_add_types`) for `card_of` to union into the copied types, cleared wherever `copying_remove_supertypes` is cleared
